title: Document POST /skills/<name>/run in the local API contract
head: codex/run-now-contract
body:
## What

Documents the `POST /skills/<name>/run` endpoint in the local API contract per decision #52.

Adds new endpoint with:
- Same Bearer authentication as other endpoints
- Returns `202` with `{"status":"queued","skill":"<name>"}`
- Returns `404` with `{"error":"unknown_skill"}`
- Returns `409` with `{"error":"paused"}`
- Returns `401` like other endpoints

Runs go through the scheduler, so pause, resources, and ask-first constraints still apply.

Updates `docs/local-api.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. No Rig button yet; Mac guide uses curl for testing.

Also notes decision #46: when service token is missing, service logs "no token found" and Rig shows "Not connected yet".

Endpoint count increases from 10 to 11. Matches agent-core implementation (`T16b` job `J7`).

## Checks (rerun by coordinator)

Docs only. `git diff --check` → clean.
